_comment: Staged-photo provenance for the AVP. Every file here is a real photograph uploaded by a human, not generated imagery. D7 in the brief asks for 3-5 candidates so the AI can be tested; the winner is chosen on detection quality and logged in capture/takes/photo-test.md. Binaries are NOT committed (see .gitignore) — run `pnpm run photos` to fetch them.
policy: Real photos only. No AI-generated imagery (brief section 7). Prefer CC0/public domain, then CC BY, then CC BY-SA, so the finished video carries no attribution obligation the owner has not agreed to.
